name: Kerkafalva (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of green and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Kerkafalva (a blue shield with a yellow oak tree and a wavy stripe) above a yellow scroll inscribed KERKAFALVA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
